tasks.name: [UI1] the Board puts waiting tasks in WAITING, active tasks in their phase's column, stopped tasks in STOPPED and other ended tasks in TRUSTED
[UI1] STOPPED groups the dead tasks, then the blocked tasks, then the rest, on the Board and in the STOPPED list
[UI1] the counts, the focus and the next running task come from the tags
[UI1] the tags alone decide: unknown state names classify the same, and a state that contradicts its tags follows the tags
[UI1] the task-ui keeps no list of active or ended state names
